en.detectionDiagnosticsCopyHint: Clipboard access is unavailable. The report is selected for manual copying.
en.detectionDiagnosticsError: The report could not be prepared. Try Refresh again.
en.detectionDiagnosticsPrivacy: Local report, without video links, cookies or signatures. Nothing is sent.
en.detectionDiagnosticsAccessError: Open Alcydeo’s details in chrome://extensions to review site access.
en.cropHint: Select an area of the video to export as a new MP4. The original is kept.
en.cropDrawHint: Drag to draw a new area. Drag inside it to move, or use its handles to resize. Arrow keys move it by 1 pixel; hold Shift for 10 pixels.
en.cropRange: Choose an area of at least 2 × 2 pixels entirely inside the video.
en.chromeAccessRestricted: Chrome settings restrict access to this site.
en.openWebPageHint: Open a website containing a video to detect its sources.
en.tiktokHint: Keep the TikTok tab and manager open. After interruption, resume restarts this file from the beginning.
en.manager_tools_description: Trim a video or join clips in the order you choose. Processing stays on your device.
en.popupContinue: Downloads continue when this popup closes. Keep the manager tab open for segmented streams.
en.conversionOptionsHint: Defaults for MP4 conversion. Quality, resolution or audio changes may require re-encoding. Size and speed depend on the source and your computer.
en.liveNoSource: Choose a source or paste its URL
en.liveHint: Save received HLS segments directly, keeping the source quality. This mode supports unencrypted TS/fMP4 with audio and video in the same stream. Keep the manager open. For other sources use Tab capture.
en.liveBoundary: Starts at a recent complete segment, which may include a few seconds before your click. Stop and save finishes the current segment, then creates a checked MP4. Earlier broadcast content is not recovered.
en.liveAudio: This live stream has separate audio. Use a combined HLS source or Tab capture; no silent video-only file is saved.
en.notLive: This is not a running HLS live stream. Use Download for a finished video, or choose another source.
en.liveGap: Live segments became unavailable. Recording stopped; only the contiguous received part is kept.
en.liveVariant: This HLS live variant is not supported. Try a standard complete-segment source or Tab capture.
en.liveEmpty: No complete live segment was received. No empty video was saved.
en.liveInterrupted: Live recording was interrupted. Save the received part; missing broadcast time cannot be recovered.
en.notice_liveIncomplete: Partial live recording: this file contains only the contiguous received part.
en.helpLocal: The help site is prepared locally and has not been published yet.
en.sizeFilterHint: Unknown sizes remain visible. Playlist sizes are not video sizes.
en.blockedHint: One domain or URL per line, including its subdomains. All other sites are scanned when automatic detection is enabled.
en.convertHint: Local MP4 conversion to H.264/AAC. Unsupported codecs are reported.
en.compressHint: Create a local H.264/AAC MP4 with the compression defaults in Settings. A smaller file is not guaranteed.
en.mergeHint: Choose 2–20 clips and order them. MP4 is normalized up to 720p/30 fps. Each clip must have one video track and the same audio layout.
en.trimHint: Drag the handles to choose the start and end, preview the selection, then save it as MP4.
en.trimRange: Choose a valid range within the video duration.
en.mergeTracks: These clips cannot be merged with the supported track layout or codec configuration.
en.recordHint: Capture the current tab from the popup, or choose a screen here. Uses a higher bitrate and up to the source resolution. Keep this manager open.
en.recordNoAudio: No audio was shared. Stop and select the tab again with its audio if needed.
en.recordingInterrupted: Recording was interrupted. The flushed part can be checked and saved. A new recording needs your selection again.
en.recordingDenied: Recording was not allowed or the chooser was closed.
en.recordingUnavailable: Chrome could not capture the selected surface.
en.recordingSlow: Recording stopped because storage could not keep up. The available part is retained.
en.notice_recordingIncomplete: Recovered recording: this file contains only the captured part.
en.cloudHint: Send only the file you choose, when you click Send. No automatic synchronization.
en.gofilePublic: Gofile needs no sign-in and creates a public sharing link. Anyone with the link can access the file. Retention follows Gofile’s rules.
en.cloudConfigurationHint: An OAuth application must be registered for this extension ID. Google Drive uses a Chrome Extension client at build time; OneDrive uses a public SPA client with this redirect URI. No client secret belongs in the extension.
en.cloudKeepOpen: Keep the manager open. A temporary local copy holds the selected file. Removing a cloud entry clears its local copy and leaves the remote file.
en.gofileRestart: Gofile does not offer resumable chunks here. Resuming sends the file again from the start.
en.cloudSetup: OAuth is not configured for this local build. See connection configuration.
en.cloudAuth: Connect or reconnect the selected cloud account.
en.cloudNetwork: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and retry.
en.cloudResponse: The service did not confirm a valid uploaded file.
en.cloudRate: The service limits uploads. Wait before retrying.
en.cloudExpired: The upload session expired. Resuming starts a new upload. Check your cloud for a possibly completed file.
en.cloudInput: Choose the local file again; its temporary copy is missing or incomplete.
en.cloudInterrupted: The manager closed or the upload stopped. Resume when ready.
en.formatsScope: Original file downloads; these extensions do not guarantee that Chrome can play or convert every codec. M3U8 and MPD describe segmented streams.
en.featureLimits: Chrome desktop. Local tests cover originals, unencrypted HLS VOD and single-period DASH. DRM and universal codec support are excluded. Cast is experimental; receiver tests remain pending. Capture quality depends on the source and PC.
en.cloudPcloudHint: No sign-in here: paste an existing pCloud upload link and choose the folder’s data region. The folder owner needs a pCloud account. This deposits your file in that folder; it does not create a public download link.
en.cloudPcloudLink: Enter a valid pCloud upload link or code and check the folder’s region. Download share links are not upload links.
en.cloudPcloudQuota: The destination folder has reached its space or file limit.
en.cloudPcloudSent: pCloud confirmed the deposit. The folder owner can retrieve the file; no public download link was created.
en.cloudRestart: Retrying sends the whole file again. If the last response was lost, check the destination first to avoid a duplicate.
en.cloudValidation: Cloud protocols are tested locally. Real provider transfers still need validation; MegaUp is experimental. pCloud needs an existing upload link.
en.cloudOnefichierHint: Experimental sharing without an account. Anyone with the link can access the file. Storage is not guaranteed after 15 days; keep your original. Availability may be delayed after sending.
en.cloudOnefichierPending: Sending file. An exact percentage is unavailable for this destination; waiting for confirmation.
en.err_cloudOnefichierUnavailable: 1fichier did not provide a valid upload destination. No file was sent during this attempt. Try later or choose another destination.
en.cloudSendAll: Send to all clouds without setup
en.cloudSendAllHint: Gofile · MegaUp · 1fichier · Turbobit. Each service keeps its own limits.
en.cloudClearTemporaryHint: Deletes local Cloud copies and cancels queued uploads. Originals and sharing links are kept.
en.cloudTemporaryCleared: Temporary files deleted. Transfer history and sharing links are kept.
en.cloudTemporaryBusy: A transfer or preparation is in progress. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before cleaning up.
en.cloudTemporaryFailed: Some temporary copies could not be deleted. Try again.
en.cloudKeepOpenShort: Keep this page open while sending.
en.concurrentFilesHint: 1 to 8 files at a time, independently of connections per file. Queued files start as soon as a slot is free.
en.concurrentFilesChangeHint: Lowering the limit lets current downloads finish. Conversions still run one at a time.
en.cloudTurbobitHint: Experimental sharing without an account, up to 200 MB per file. Anyone with the link can access it; guest storage lasts up to 7 days. Keep the original and check the file on Turbobit.
en.err_cloudTurbobitUnavailable: Turbobit did not provide a valid guest upload destination. No file was sent. Try later or choose another destination.
en.playlistSnapshot: This evolving mix includes only the titles currently loaded by YouTube. Select the ones to save; future suggestions are not included.
en.playlistEmpty: No accessible videos in this playlist.
en.playlistHint: A muted work tab prepares each video. Keep the manager open. Only accessible videos can be saved; private, removed or refused videos are reported separately.
en.playlistRead: The full playlist could not be read. Refresh its YouTube page, then scan again.
en.playlistLimit: This playlist exceeds the local reading limit (5,000 videos or 100 pages). The incomplete list will not start a full download.
en.playlistPlayer: The player did not provide a usable source. Play the video normally on YouTube, then retry this video.
en.playlistInterrupted: The playlist is paused after an interruption. Resume to continue without repeating saved videos.
en.playlistTabClosed: The work tab was closed or changed. Resume the playlist to continue.
en.playlistStopped: The playlist is paused after an interruption. Resume to continue without repeating saved videos.
en.playlistNotSaved: The playlist is paused after an interruption. Resume to continue without repeating saved videos.
en.playlistQuality: No source is available at or below the chosen quality.
en.manager_queue_description: Your downloads, all in one place.
en.manager_library_description: Your videos, downloads and processing jobs in one place.
en.manager_record_description: Capture a moment. Keep it on your device.
en.manager_cloud_description: Send a chosen file to your preferred destination.
en.manager_help_description: A little guidance, whenever you need it.
en.managerNoResultsHint: Try another title or clear your filters.
en.managerEmptyHint: Download a video from a page using the Alcydeo icon. You’ll find it here.
en.detectionSettingsHint: Choose what appears in your download list.
en.appearanceSettingsHint: A comfortable view, day or night.
en.destinationSettingsHint: Decide how and where your files are saved.
en.tvKeepOpen: Keep this player open during playback.
en.sourceRetryHint: The check found an invalid, unavailable or too-small source. Reload the original player, then scan again.
en.manager_tv_description: Cast a detected video or play a local file to cast its tab.
en.tvExperimental: Experimental · receiver playback is not yet validated on real devices.
en.tvNoAirplay: AirPlay is not available in Chrome on this device.
en.tvNoDevice: No compatible receiver found. Check that both devices use the same network.
en.tvNotSupported: This source or browser cannot start remote playback. Try casting the original tab from Chrome’s menu.
en.tvHint: Native Cast depends on Chrome, the receiver and the media format. Alcydeo adds no media relay server. Tab casting can use the original site’s player when direct playback is unsuitable.
en.sourceCheckHint: A small sample is checked before download. This does not validate the complete file. Refresh to test the proposals again.
en.err_tooSmall: This source is smaller than the minimum size selected in Settings.
en.tvAirplayWindows: AirPlay is unavailable in Chrome on Windows: this browser does not expose an AirPlay sender. An AirPlay-only Apple TV is not a Google Cast receiver.
en.tvStreamTab: This stream uses the original site’s player. To show it on TV, return to that tab and use Chrome’s Cast menu.
en.tvDeviceUnconfirmed: Chrome has not reported a compatible receiver for this video. You can retry or cast the original tab.
en.tvDeviceChecking: Receiver availability has not been confirmed by Chrome.
en.tvShortClip: Chrome 156 can refuse direct remote playback for clips of 15 seconds or less. Use tab casting for these clips.
en.tvNoConnection: Chrome could not communicate with the receiver. Check compatibility or cast the tab from Chrome’s menu.
en.tvPermission: Chrome blocked receiver selection. Check the browser’s casting policy or use its Cast menu.
en.tvActivation: Click Cast again to open receiver selection.
en.tvBusy: A receiver picker is already open. Finish that selection first.
en.tvMediaCodec: Chrome cannot decode this source in this player. Try the original tab or another quality.
en.tvMediaNetwork: The video could not load here. Its URL may have expired or may require the original page’s session. Return to that tab.
en.tvOriginalMissing: The original tab was closed or changed. Open the video page again and detect its source.
en.tvChromeSteps: Return to the original tab, play the video, then use Chrome’s ⋮ menu → Cast, save, and share → Cast… → Sources → Cast tab. Choose your TV. This selector is opened from Chrome’s menu.
en.tvNetworkHint: Use a Google Cast-compatible receiver on the same local network. If Chrome cannot find it either, check the network, VPN and firewall settings.
en.tvWebNoMedia: Paste a direct video URL, then choose a TV and click Play on TV.
en.tvWebHint: The separate Google Cast web page loads Google’s SDK. After you choose a receiver, its player receives the selected video URL and title. Cookies and passwords are not transferred.
en.tvWebUnavailable: The Google Cast web player is unavailable in this installation. Use Chrome’s Cast menu for this local test.
en.tvWebLoadError: The receiver did not load the video. Its link may require cookies, have expired or use an unsupported format. Cast the original tab instead.
en.tvWebSdkError: Google Cast controls could not load. Check Chrome, the connection and access to Google’s SDK.
en.tvCastBuiltIn: Choose your TV in Chrome’s receiver picker. Keep this tab open for playback controls.
en.tvCastAutoQuality: The TV receives the complete stream and selects a supported quality and audio track.
en.tvCastTimeout: The receiver did not confirm playback in time. Retry or cast the original tab.
en.tvCastLocalFile: A file stored only on your PC is not a URL the TV can open. For a local file, play it in Chrome and use Cast tab.
en.tvCast_idle: Choose a receiver to cast this video.
en.tvCast_loading: The receiver is loading the video…
en.tvFileIntro: Play the file here, then choose a casting method supported by your receiver.
en.tvFileChooseSaved: Select the saved file on your PC:
en.tvFileStepPlay: Open your video file in Alcydeo and start playback.
en.tvFileStepMenu: Open Chrome’s ⋮ menu → Cast, save, and share → Cast…. This button shows instructions; the receiver picker opens from Chrome’s menu.
en.tvFileStepTab: Under Sources, choose Cast tab, then your TV, for example NVIDIA SHIELD.
en.tvFileKeepOpen: Keep this tab open. Use the video controls for playback and Chrome’s Cast control to stop casting. Tab casting can use more CPU than sending a video link.
en.tvFilePrivacy: Files stay on this PC; native Chrome Cast sends media to the selected receiver. Alcydeo does not upload to a hosting service.
en.tvFileCodec: Chrome cannot play this file. Try converting it to MP4 in Video tools.
en.tvFileChooseAgain: The retained file is unavailable. Select your saved copy on this PC.
en.tvFilePlayFirst: Start playback in this player, then click Cast.
en.tvFileAccess: Enable “Allow access to file URLs” on Alcydeo’s Chrome extension details page, then reopen this player.
en.tvFileAccessHint: Cast needs optional access to the saved file. No file is uploaded. Once prepared, click Cast in this player.
en.tvFileCopyHint: Chrome needs a saved file for native Cast. Preparation opens Save as to create a local copy; the original is kept.
en.tvFileCopyFailed: The local copy could not be prepared. Retry; no receiver connection was made.
en.tvFilePath: This file path is unsupported. Select a video and prepare a local copy. Network shares are not opened.
en.tvFileShort: Chrome’s native remote playback requires a video longer than 15 seconds. Use the tab-casting guide for this clip.
en.tvFileReceiverLimit: Chrome’s file Cast button supports selected Chromecast devices and Google TV Streamer. Nvidia Shield is excluded by this API; cast the player tab from Chrome’s menu instead.
en.tvWebPreviewUnavailable: Local preview is unavailable for this source. Your TV may support its format; you can still try casting.
en.trimTimeHint: Enter seconds or m:ss / h:mm:ss, with up to three decimal places.
en.batchSequential: Files are processed one at a time. Original files are kept. Choose any missing local copies below.
en.batchQueued: $1 files added to the processing queue.
en.chooseLocalFiles: Select the saved local file to continue.
en.compressionDefaultsHint: Used for Compress in the library. Quality, maximum resolution and audio bitrate affect size and processing time.
en.captureQualityHint: Keeps up to 4K at 30 fps with a higher bitrate. Detail depends on the captured source; enlarging pixels cannot restore missing detail.
en.recordDetectedHint: Records a supported HLS live source directly. Other playing sources use tab capture.
en.previewUnavailable: Chrome cannot preview this file. Try a compatible MP4.
en.mergeVisualHint: Drag clips to reorder them, or use the arrows. Click a thumbnail to preview a clip.
en.castReuseFile: Reuse a saved Chrome file without making another copy:
en.cloudProviderRemoved: This provider was removed. Cancel or delete this old task.
en.conversionHint: MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio. One file at a time; keep the manager open. The original is kept. Compatible tracks are copied; other supported tracks are re-encoded, which can take longer and change quality.
en.conversionRestartHint: Conversion runs one file at a time. After a pause or manager closure it restarts from the saved input.
en.err_conversionCodec: Chrome cannot convert every audio/video track in this file to H.264/AAC. The original is kept; no incomplete MP4 was saved.
en.err_conversionInput: Choose the original video again; its local preparation was interrupted or is unavailable.
en.clearHistoryHint: Remove finished, failed and cancelled records and their temporary files from Alcydeo, across all pages and filters, including favorites. Saved files and active or paused downloads are kept.
en.historyCleared: History cleared. Saved files were kept.
en.multipartEnable: Use multiple connections for compatible files and DASH
en.multipartHint: Keep the manager open. Compatible audio/video tracks can download together. Splitting one resource requires reliable byte ranges and a strong version validator; otherwise standard transfer is used. Speed depends on the server and your connection.
en.notice_multipartUnavailable: Parallel parts are unavailable for this source. Using standard transfer.
en.err_sourceRestricted: The source refused access to this stream. This video cannot be downloaded in the current player session.
en.err_sourcePending: Play the video for a few seconds so its download source becomes available.
en.sabrRestartHint: If this transfer is interrupted, resuming starts again from the beginning.
en.saveAsk: Show Save As for every download
en.downloadFolderHint: Files are saved in Chrome’s chosen download directory, inside this subfolder. Change the main directory in Chrome’s download settings.
en.chromeDownloadSettings: Choose the main folder in Chrome
en.err_saveDialog: Saving did not start. Try again and choose a name and location in the Save As dialog.
en.err_chooseQuality: This source now lists several qualities. Reopen Alcydeo on the video page, find qualities and select one again.
en.err_manifestLoop: The source links back to a playlist already visited. Refresh the original player and detect the source again.
en.globalDetectionHint: Enabled by default. Chrome grants site access at installation. You can pause detection here or limit site access in Chrome.
en.err_html: The source returned an HTML page instead of media. The download was stopped. Refresh the original player and detect its media source again.
en.err_notMedia: This response is not a supported media file. Refresh the player and detect its media source again.
en.appDescription: Find videos, save them locally and keep your library private.
en.empty: Play a video to get started
en.emptyHint: Play the video, then refresh the page if it is still not listed.
en.keepOpen: Keep this manager open while segmented media is processing. Closing Chrome stops active tasks.
en.title: File name
en.privacy: No telemetry. Library and tasks stay in this browser. Network access is limited to sources you allow.
en.err_network: The source is unavailable. Check the connection or refresh the page.
en.err_expired: The session or source link expired. Refresh the original page.
en.err_unsupported: This stream variant is not supported yet. Try a direct source or another quality.
en.err_encrypted: Encrypted or protected media is not supported.
en.err_invalid: The file could not be validated. Check that you selected the downloaded file.
en.err_space: Not enough temporary storage. Remove old tasks and try again.
en.err_excluded: This source is outside Alcydeo’s supported scope.
en.err_blocked: Detection is disabled for this host in Settings.
en.err_interrupted: Processing stopped. Reopen the source and resume when possible.
en.notice_timedMetadataSkipped: Timed metadata (0x15) was omitted from the saved file.
en.deleteSelectionHint: Remove the selected eligible records and their temporary files. Saved disk files and active or paused tasks are kept.
en.err_saveInterrupted: Chrome has not confirmed saving. Check its downloads or an open Save As dialog, then retry saving this prepared file.
en.cloudMegaupHint: Experimental sharing without an account. Files are public and may expire after 30 days without activity. Keep your original file.
en.err_cloudMegaupUnavailable: MegaUp’s upload page is unavailable or has changed. No transfer started. Try again later or choose another destination.
en.err_cloudFileTooLarge: This file exceeds the destination’s upload limit. Choose a smaller file.

es.detectionDiagnosticsCopyHint: El portapapeles no está disponible. El informe está seleccionado para copiarlo manualmente.
es.detectionDiagnosticsError: No se pudo preparar el informe. Vuelve a pulsar Actualizar.
es.detectionDiagnosticsPrivacy: Informe local, sin enlaces de vídeo, cookies ni firmas. No se envía nada.
es.detectionDiagnosticsAccessError: Abre los detalles de Alcydeo en chrome://extensions para revisar el acceso a sitios.
es.cropHint: Selecciona un área del vídeo para exportarla como un MP4 nuevo. Se conserva el original.
es.cropDrawHint: Arrastra para dibujar un área nueva. Arrastra dentro para moverla o usa los tiradores para cambiar su tamaño. Las flechas la mueven 1 píxel; mantén Mayús para 10 píxeles.
es.cropRange: Elige un área de al menos 2 × 2 píxeles completamente dentro del vídeo.
es.chromeAccessRestricted: Los ajustes de Chrome restringen el acceso a este sitio.
es.openWebPageHint: Abre un sitio con un vídeo para detectar sus fuentes.
es.tiktokHint: Mantén abiertas la pestaña TikTok y el gestor. Tras una interrupción, reanudar reinicia este archivo desde el principio.
es.manager_tools_description: Recorta un vídeo o une clips en el orden que elijas. El procesamiento es local.
es.popupContinue: Las descargas continúan al cerrar esta ventana. Mantén abierta la pestaña del gestor para flujos segmentados.
es.conversionOptionsHint: Valores predeterminados para MP4. Cambiar calidad, resolución o audio puede requerir recodificar. Tamaño y velocidad dependen del original y del equipo.
es.liveNoSource: Elige una fuente o pega su URL
es.liveUrl: O una URL de flujo HLS (.m3u8)
es.liveHint: Guarda directamente los segmentos HLS con la calidad original. Admite TS/fMP4 sin cifrar con audio y vídeo en el mismo flujo. Mantén abierto el gestor. Para otras fuentes usa Captura de pestaña.
es.liveBoundary: Empieza en un segmento completo reciente, que puede incluir unos segundos anteriores al clic. Detener y guardar termina el segmento actual y crea un MP4 comprobado. No recupera la emisión anterior.
es.liveAudio: Este directo tiene audio separado. Usa una fuente HLS combinada o Captura de pestaña; no se guarda un vídeo sin su audio.
es.notLive: No es un flujo HLS en directo activo. Usa Descargar para un vídeo finalizado o elige otra fuente.
es.liveGap: Hay segmentos en directo no disponibles. Se detuvo la grabación y solo se conserva la parte continua recibida.
es.liveVariant: Esta variante HLS en directo no es compatible. Prueba una fuente de segmentos completos o Captura de pestaña.
es.liveEmpty: No se recibió ningún segmento completo. No se guardó un vídeo vacío.
es.liveInterrupted: Se interrumpió la grabación. Guarda la parte recibida; no se recupera el tiempo de emisión perdido.
es.notice_liveIncomplete: Grabación parcial: este archivo solo contiene la parte continua recibida.
es.helpLocal: El sitio de ayuda está preparado localmente y aún no está publicado.
es.sizeFilterHint: Los tamaños desconocidos siguen visibles. Una lista no tiene el tamaño del vídeo.
es.blockedHint: Un dominio o URL por línea, incluidos sus subdominios. Los demás sitios se examinan con la detección automática.
es.convertHint: Conversión local a MP4 H.264/AAC. Se indican los códecs no admitidos.
es.compressHint: Crea un MP4 H.264/AAC local con los valores de compresión de Ajustes. No se garantiza un archivo menor.
es.mergeHint: Elige 2–20 clips y ordénalos. MP4 hasta 720p/30 fps. Cada clip debe tener una pista de vídeo y la misma distribución de audio.
es.trimHint: Arrastra los marcadores para elegir el inicio y el final, previsualiza y guarda la selección en MP4.
es.trimRange: Elige un tramo válido dentro del vídeo.
es.mergeTracks: Estos clips no se pueden unir con las pistas o códecs admitidos.
es.recordHint: Captura la pestaña desde la ventana del complemento o elige una pantalla aquí. Mayor bitrate y resolución de origen. Mantén abierto el gestor.
es.recordNoAudio: No se compartió audio. Detén y vuelve a elegir la pestaña con audio si lo necesitas.
es.recordingInterrupted: La grabación se interrumpió. Se puede comprobar y guardar la parte escrita. Una nueva grabación requiere otra selección.
es.recordingDenied: La grabación no fue autorizada o se cerró el selector.
es.recordingUnavailable: Chrome no pudo capturar la superficie elegida.
es.recordingSlow: La grabación se detuvo porque el almacenamiento no pudo seguir el ritmo. Se conserva la parte disponible.
es.notice_recordingIncomplete: Grabación recuperada: solo contiene la parte capturada.
es.cloudHint: Envía solo el archivo elegido al pulsar Enviar. Sin sincronización automática.
es.gofilePublic: Gofile no requiere iniciar sesión y crea un enlace público. Quien tenga el enlace puede acceder. La conservación depende de Gofile.
es.cloudConfigurationHint: Se debe registrar una aplicación OAuth para este ID de extensión. Drive usa un cliente Chrome Extension al compilar; OneDrive un cliente SPA público con esta URI. La extensión no lleva secretos.
es.cloudKeepOpen: Mantén el gestor abierto. Una copia temporal conserva el archivo elegido. Eliminar la entrada borra su copia local y conserva el archivo remoto.
es.gofileRestart: Gofile no permite reanudar por partes aquí. Reanudar vuelve a enviar desde el inicio.
es.cloudSetup: OAuth no está configurado en este build local. Consulta la configuración.
es.cloudAuth: Conecta o vuelve a conectar la cuenta elegida.
es.cloudNetwork: El envío no terminó. Revisa la conexión y reintenta.
es.cloudResponse: El servicio no confirmó un archivo válido.
es.cloudRate: El servicio limita los envíos. Espera antes de reintentar.
es.cloudExpired: La sesión caducó. Reanudar crea otro envío. Comprueba si ya hay un archivo completo en tu nube.
es.cloudInput: Elige de nuevo el archivo local; falta su copia temporal o está incompleta.
es.cloudInterrupted: El gestor se cerró o el envío se detuvo. Reanuda cuando quieras.
es.formatsScope: Descargas de originales; estas extensiones no garantizan reproducir o convertir todos los códecs en Chrome. M3U8 y MPD describen emisiones por segmentos.
es.featureLimits: Chrome de escritorio. Pruebas locales de originales, HLS VOD sin cifrar y DASH de un período. Sin DRM ni compatibilidad universal de códecs. Cast es experimental; falta validar receptores. La captura depende de la fuente y del PC.
es.cloudPcloudRegion: Región de datos de la carpeta
es.cloudPcloudHint: Sin iniciar sesión aquí: pega un enlace de subida pCloud existente y elige la región de la carpeta. Su propietario necesita una cuenta pCloud. El archivo se deposita allí sin crear un enlace público de descarga.
es.cloudPcloudLink: Introduce un enlace o código de subida pCloud válido y comprueba la región. Los enlaces de descarga no son de subida.
es.cloudPcloudQuota: La carpeta de destino alcanzó el límite de espacio o archivos.
es.cloudPcloudSent: pCloud confirmó el depósito. El propietario puede recuperar el archivo; no se creó enlace público.
es.cloudRestart: Reintentar envía el archivo entero. Si se perdió la respuesta, revisa el destino para evitar duplicados.
es.cloudValidation: Los protocolos se prueban localmente. Falta validar envíos reales; MegaUp es experimental. pCloud necesita un enlace de subida existente.
es.cloudOnefichierHint: Uso experimental sin cuenta. Cualquiera con el enlace puede acceder. El almacenamiento no se garantiza después de 15 días; conserva el original. La disponibilidad puede tardar tras el envío.
es.cloudOnefichierPending: Enviando archivo. No hay porcentaje exacto para este destino; esperando confirmación.

es.err_tooSmall: Esta fuente es menor que el tamaño mínimo elegido en Ajustes.

es.tvStreamTab: Esta emisión usa el reproductor del sitio original. Vuelve a esa pestaña y usa el menú Enviar de Chrome.
es.tvDeviceUnconfirmed: Chrome no indica un receptor compatible para este vídeo. Puedes reintentar o enviar la pestaña original.
es.tvDeviceChecking: Chrome aún no confirma la disponibilidad de receptores.
es.tvShortClip: Chrome 156 puede rechazar la reproducción remota directa de clips de 15 segundos o menos. Usa el envío de pestaña.
es.tvNoConnection: Chrome no pudo comunicarse con el receptor. Comprueba su compatibilidad o transmite la pestaña desde el menú de Chrome.
es.tvPermission: Chrome bloqueó la selección. Revisa las políticas de transmisión o usa su menú Enviar.
es.tvActivation: Pulsa Enviar otra vez para elegir un receptor.
es.tvBusy: Ya hay un selector abierto. Termina esa selección primero.
es.tvMediaCodec: Chrome no puede decodificar esta fuente aquí. Prueba la pestaña original u otra calidad.
es.tvMediaNetwork: El vídeo no cargó aquí. La URL puede haber caducado o requerir la sesión de la página original. Vuelve a esa pestaña.
es.tvOriginalMissing: La pestaña original se cerró o cambió. Abre otra vez la página y detecta la fuente.
es.tvChromeSteps: Vuelve a la pestaña original, reproduce el vídeo y abre ⋮ de Chrome → Enviar, guardar y compartir → Enviar… → Fuentes → Enviar pestaña. Elige tu TV. Este selector se abre desde Chrome.
es.tvNetworkHint: Usa un receptor Google Cast en la misma red local. Si Chrome tampoco lo encuentra, revisa red, VPN y cortafuegos.
es.tvWebNoMedia: Pega la URL directa del vídeo, elige TV y pulsa Reproducir en TV.
es.tvWebHint: La página web separada carga el SDK de Google Cast. Al elegir un receptor, su reproductor recibe la URL y el título. No se transfieren cookies ni contraseñas.
es.tvWebUnavailable: El reproductor web Google Cast no está disponible en esta instalación. Usa el menú Enviar de Chrome para esta prueba local.
es.tvWebLoadError: El receptor no cargó el vídeo. El enlace puede requerir cookies, haber caducado o usar un formato no compatible. Envía la pestaña original.
es.tvWebSdkError: No se cargaron los controles Google Cast. Revisa Chrome, la conexión y el acceso al SDK de Google.
es.tvCastBuiltIn: Elige tu TV en el selector de Chrome. Mantén esta pestaña abierta para los controles.
es.tvCastAutoQuality: La TV recibe la emisión completa y elige calidad y audio compatibles.
es.tvCastTimeout: El receptor no confirmó la reproducción a tiempo. Reintenta o transmite la pestaña original.
es.tvCastLocalFile: Un archivo solo en el PC no tiene una URL accesible para la TV. Ábrelo en Chrome y transmite la pestaña.
es.tvCast_idle: Elige un receptor para este vídeo.

es.tvFileIntro: Reproduce el archivo aquí y elige un método de transmisión compatible con tu receptor.

es.tvFileStepTab: En Fuentes elige Enviar pestaña y tu TV, por ejemplo NVIDIA SHIELD.
es.tvFileKeepOpen: Mantén esta pestaña abierta. Controla el vídeo aquí y detén la transmisión desde Chrome. Transmitir la pestaña puede usar más CPU que enviar un enlace.
es.tvFilePrivacy: Los archivos quedan en este PC; Cast de Chrome envía el vídeo al receptor elegido. Alcydeo no sube a un alojamiento.
es.tvFileInvalid: Elige un archivo de vídeo no vacío.
es.tvFileCodec: Chrome no puede reproducir este archivo. Prueba convertirlo a MP4 en Herramientas de vídeo.
es.tvFileChooseAgain: La copia conservada no está disponible. Selecciona el archivo guardado en el PC.
es.tvFilePlayFirst: Inicia la reproducción aquí y pulsa Transmitir.
es.tvFileAccess: Activa «Permitir acceso a URL de archivo» en los detalles de Alcydeo en Chrome y vuelve a abrir el reproductor.
es.tvFileAccessHint: Cast necesita acceso opcional al archivo guardado. No se sube ningún archivo. Tras prepararlo, pulsa Transmitir aquí.
es.tvFileCopyHint: Chrome necesita un archivo guardado para Cast nativo. La preparación abre Guardar como para crear una copia local; conserva el original.
es.tvFileCopyFailed: No se pudo preparar la copia local. Reintenta; no se conectó a ningún receptor.
es.tvFilePath: Esta ruta no es compatible. Selecciona un vídeo y prepara una copia local. No se abren recursos de red.
es.tvFileShort: La reproducción remota nativa de Chrome requiere más de 15 segundos. Usa la guía de transmisión de pestaña para este clip.
es.tvFileReceiverLimit: El botón Cast de archivos de Chrome admite ciertos Chromecast y Google TV Streamer. Esta API excluye Nvidia Shield; transmite la pestaña del reproductor desde el menú de Chrome.
es.tvWebPreviewUnavailable: La vista previa local no está disponible. Tu TV puede admitir este formato; puedes intentar transmitirlo.
es.trimTimeHint: Introduce segundos o m:ss / h:mm:ss, con hasta tres decimales.
es.batchSequential: Los archivos se procesan uno a uno y se conservan los originales. Elige las copias locales que falten.
es.compressionDefaultsHint: Se usa al comprimir en la biblioteca. La calidad, resolución y audio influyen en tamaño y tiempo.
es.captureQualityHint: Hasta 4K a 30 fps con mayor bitrate. El detalle depende de la fuente; ampliar píxeles no lo recupera.
es.recordDetectedHint: Graba directamente HLS en vivo compatible. Otras fuentes usan captura de pestaña.
es.previewUnavailable: Chrome no puede previsualizar este archivo. Prueba un MP4 compatible.
es.mergeVisualHint: Arrastra los clips o usa las flechas para ordenarlos. Pulsa una miniatura para previsualizar.
es.castReuseFile: Reutiliza un archivo de Chrome sin crear otra copia:
es.cloudProviderRemoved: Este proveedor fue eliminado. Cancela o elimina la tarea antigua.
es.conversionHint: MP4 con vídeo H.264 y audio AAC. Un archivo a la vez; mantén abierto el gestor. Se conserva el original. Las pistas compatibles se copian; las demás pistas admitidas se recodifican, lo que puede tardar más y cambiar la calidad.
es.conversionRestartHint: La conversión procesa un archivo a la vez. Tras una pausa o al cerrar el gestor, reinicia desde la entrada guardada.
es.err_conversionCodec: Chrome no puede convertir todas las pistas de este archivo a H.264/AAC. Se conserva el original y no se guardó un MP4 incompleto.
es.err_conversionInput: Elige de nuevo el vídeo original; su preparación local se interrumpió o no está disponible.
es.clearHistoryHint: Se eliminarán de Alcydeo los registros finalizados, fallidos y cancelados y sus archivos temporales, en todas las páginas y filtros, incluidos los favoritos. Se conservan los archivos guardados y las descargas activas o pausadas.
es.historyCleared: Historial borrado. Se conservaron los archivos guardados.

es.notice_multipartUnavailable: Esta fuente no admite partes paralelas. Se usa la transferencia normal.
es.err_sourceRestricted: La fuente rechazó el acceso a este flujo. No se puede descargar el vídeo en la sesión actual.

fr.openWebPageHint: Ouvrez un site contenant une vidéo pour détecter ses sources.
